title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 5 year-round staff, the MSP technician and the irrigation dealer's service technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each CSF outcome is carried out today. Owner and General Manager (2026-07-20): the farm's mission is understood by everyone interviewed; cyber risk is not part of yearly planning for crops, insurance or equipment; positive risks, security outcomes and performance measures are not discussed; hardware and software are bought through dealers without security checks; he knows the insurer has a breach hotline but not the claim process. Office Manager (2026-07-21): nobody is designated to own security; the MSP and the dealers report nothing unless asked; the FMIS vendor's SOC 2 report has never been requested and the MSP has never been reviewed; the old office desktop was given to a relative in 2025 without a recorded wipe; paper with personal information is shredded in the office; no breach procedure, threat information source or incident record exists. Irrigation and Equipment Technician (2026-07-22): only he has run the pumps and pivots by hand and nothing is written; no recorded baseline for the controller, gateway or pivot settings; no security training for his role. MSP technician: the MSP can isolate and reimage the office computers remotely; no vulnerability scanning is done; no restore test has been run. Dealer service technician: the controller program is kept only on the dealer's laptop; controller and gateway firmware have never been updated; there are no maintenance records or replacement plan for the 2019 gateway; the controller and gateway keep no log the farm can read. Staff (2026-07-21 to 2026-07-23) would call the Owner and General Manager about a problem and did not know the Florida 30-day notice clock or the packer-shipper's 24-hour notice term
